【AI“杀死”数学家？邓煜：别急着落子】在接受CGTN主持人田薇的专访时，2026年
#菲尔兹奖#
得主
#邓煜#
谈及AI与数学研究的未来。他表示，面对AI带来的变化，不必过度焦虑：“别急着落子”。AI的突破并非数学研究的终点，而是人类探索新知的新起点。只要能理解AI的推导，我们就能在其肩膀上开拓新知。AI越强，
#数学#
研究的“加速器”就越强；而AI变得更强，也将帮助人类变得更强。 In an exclusive interview with CGTN, 2026 Fields Medalist Deng Yu shared his thoughts on the future of AI and mathematical research. He believes there is no need to be overly anxious about the changes AI is bringing: "Hold your horses." AI breakthroughs are not the end of mathematical research, but a new starting point for human discovery. The stronger AI becomes, the more powerful an accelerator it can be for mathematical research, and the stronger it can make us, too.
